def make_root(tmp_path, text=FIXTURE, files=(), git=False, ignore=None):
    root = tmp_path / 'repo'
    (root / 'build').mkdir(parents=True)
    (root / 'build' / 'suites.toml').write_text(text)
    for rel in files:
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text('def test_x():\n    pass\n')
    if ignore is not None:
        (root / '.gitignore').write_text(ignore)
    if git:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(root)], check=True)
    return root


def call_main(argv, root, run_one=None):
    kwargs = {'root': root}
    if run_one is not None:
        kwargs['run_one'] = run_one
    try:
        return rs.main(argv, **kwargs)
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return exc.code


class Recorder:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.calls = []
        self.codes = codes or {}

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        print(f'RUN {run.label}')
        self.calls.append(run)
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)


def suites():
    return rs.parse(tomllib.loads(FIXTURE))


def by_name(name, ss=None):
    return next(s for s in (ss or suites()) if s.name == name)

    'missing with': FIXTURE.replace('dir = "a/b"\nwith = ["pytest"]\n', 'dir = "a/b"\n'),
    'wrong type': FIXTURE.replace('pythons = ["3.13", "/usr/bin/python3"]', 'pythons = "3.13"'),
    'duplicate name': FIXTURE.replace('name = "gamma"', 'name = "alpha"'),

def test_runner_imports_stdlib_only():
    tree = ast.parse((REPO / 'build' / 'run_suites.py').read_text())
    mods = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            mods.update(a.name.split('.')[0] for a in node.names)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0:
            mods.add(node.module.split('.')[0])
    assert mods <= set(sys.stdlib_module_names), mods - set(sys.stdlib_module_names)
